spans.s:
शामुल्य, अम्, n. (probably connected with श-
मल), Ved. (perhaps) anything requiring cleansing
or expiation (as a dirty or defiled garment; according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

= शमलं शारीरं
शरीर-छिन्नस्य मलस्य धारकं वस्त्रम्).

शामूल, अम्, n., Ved. (according to some) an
old woollen garment.

समूल स-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a root,
along with the root; (अम्), ind. by the roots, with
the roots, completely.
—समूल-काषम्, ind. strik-
ing or shaking (the ground) to its very foundations.
—समूल-घातम्, ind. having destroyed by the
roots, having utterly exterminated.
सम्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken to, addressed.

1. सम्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see under सम्-
उद्-इ), spoken with, conversed; spoken to, addressed,
accosted; agreed upon, (यथा-समुदितम्, accord-
ing to agreement); consented, settled, customary.

2. सम्-उदित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under सं-
वद्), gone up, risen, ascended, rising upwards, lofty,
elevated; arisen, produced, occasioned, excited; come
together, collected, gathered together, aggregated,
united, assembled; possessed of, furnished with, en-
dowed.

सम्-उद्य, ind. having spoken together; having
concluded or agreed upon.

2. सम्-उद्य, ind. (for 1. see p. 1037, col. 1),
having sprinkled all over, having moistened.

समुद्य सम्-उद्य. See under सं-वद्,
p. 1037, and under सम्-उद्, p. 1079.

समुद्या सम्-उद्-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्,
to rise up against any one (with acc.), assail.

सम्-उषित, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelt or lived together,
stayed with; passed, spent (as time).

सम्-उह्य, ind. having brought together, having
arranged or put in order; [cf. 2. सम्-ऊह्य.]

समुह्य सम्-उह्य, सम्-उह्यमान. See under
सं-वह्.

1. सम्-ऊह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought together
or assembled or collected; (अस्), m., scil. अग्नि, a
kind of sacrificial fire (to be brought or carried by
the priest); a place prepared for the reception of a
sacrificial fire.

2. सम्-ऊह्य, ind. having brought together or
collected or assembled.

सम्-उह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being borne or
carried along; being carried by, riding on (with
inst.).

1. सम्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see under सम्-
ऊह्), borne or conveyed together, carried or borne
along, borne away; led, conducted; married.
समूढ 2. सम्-ऊढ. See col. 3.

2. सम्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, (in some senses equally
referrible to सं-वह्, see 1. सम्-ऊढ, p. 1037,
col. 3), brought together, collected; heaped up,
accumulated, assembled; associated, accompanying;
enveloped; produced quickly; crooked, bent; tamed,
tranquillised; purified, cleansed.
—समूढ-च्छन्-
दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the metres restored to their
proper order.

सम्-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, completely stupefied,
astounded; unconscious, senseless; bewildered, be-
guiled; infatuated, foolish, ignorant; disordered,
deranged; heaped, accumulated; produced rapidly;
broken; (आ), f. a kind of riddle or enigma.
—सम्-
मूढ-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or सम्मूढ-हृदय,
अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered or infatuated in mind.

सम्-उत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. woven or sewn to-
gether, (तर्द्म-समुत, having the holes sewn
together or fastened together with pins.)

समुक्ष् 1. सम्-उक्ष् (see rt. 1. उक्ष्), cl. 6. P.
-उक्षति, -उक्षितुम्, to sprinkle well or thoroughly,
wet; to besprinkle, strew, scatter or pour over, pour
out; to confer, endow.
समुक्ष् 2. सम्-उक्ष्. See rt. 2. उक्ष्.

सम्-उक्षण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling or
pouring over, shedding, effusion.

1. सम्-उक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, besprinkled, scattered,
strewed, covered; poured out, effused.

1. सम्-उक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strengthened,
augmented, exalted, (Sāy. = वर्धित.)

समुख स-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, talkative, lo-
quacious, eloquent.

सम्मुख सम्-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, facing,
fronting, being in front of, being face to face, oppo-
site; confronting, meeting, encountering; looking
towards, directed towards; propitious; (अम्), ind.
before the face, in front of.
—सम्मुख-वर्तिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, being before the eyes.

समुच् सम्-उच्, cl. 4. P. -उच्यति (Perf.
-उवोच), -उचितुम्, Ved. to delight in (with inst.);
to like to combine or blend with, (Sāy. = सम्-उच्यसि
= सङ्गच्छसि, Ṛg-veda

सम्मुच् सम्-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते,
[]
मोक्तुम्, to let loose together, pour out, discharge,
shed: Caus. -मोचयति, -यितुम्, to release, free,
set free, liberate.

सम्-उचित, अस्, आ, अम्, liked; well suited, suit-
able, fit, right, proper; appropriate, worthy; accus-
tomed, used.

सम्-उच्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected or aggregated
together, regularly arranged.

समुच्चर् सम्-उच्-चर् (-उद्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -च-
रति, -चरितुम्, to go out together; to go up, be
borne upwards, ascend.

सम्-उच्चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going or coming out
together; rising upwards together, ascending.

समुच्चल् सम्-उच्-चल् (-उद्-चल्), cl. 1. P. -च-
लति, -चलितुम्, to set out together.

समुच्चि सम्-उच्-चि (-उद्-चि), cl. 5. P. A. -चि-
नोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to heap up together, aggregate,
collect together, gather, collect; to arrange, array in
order.

सम्-उच्चय, अस्, m. collection, assemblage, ag-
gregation, accumulation, multitude, mass, aggregate;
conjunction of words or sentences (as by the particle
‘and,’ &c., see सम्-आहार); the gathering together
of two or more things independent of each other (but
associated in idea with reference to some common
action).
—समुच्चयालङ्कार (˚य-अल्˚), अस्, m. the
rhetorical ornament of conjunction, (see above.)

सम्-उच्चयित्वा (anom. ind. part.), having col-
lected, having picked up and placed in a heap.

सम्-उच्चित्य, ind. having collected or gathered
together, having arranged.
सम्-उच्चीय (anom. ind. part.), having arranged.

सम्-उच्चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being aggregated
or conjoined.

समुच्छद् सम्-उच्-छद् (-उद्-छद्), cl. 10. P.
-छादयति, -यितुम्, to uncover (the body &c.),
put off (a garment), undress.

समुच्छिद् सम्-उच्-छिद् (-उद्-छिद्), cl. 7. P.
A. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, -छेत्तुम्, to cut up or cut off
completely, cut off, tear out, tear to pieces; to eradi-
cate, exterminate, destroy utterly.

सम्-उच्छिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, completely cut up or
eradicated, utterly destroyed, perished.
—समुच्-
छिन्न-वासन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose dress is torn
off; one whose delusion is completely removed.

सम्-उच्छेद, अस्, m. cutting off completely,
destroying, utter destruction or extermination.

समुच्छुष् सम्-उच्-छुष् (-उद्-शुष्), cl. 4. P.
-छुष्यति, -छोष्टुम्, to be or become completely
dried up.

समुच्छ्रि सम्-उच्-छ्रि (-उद्-श्रि), cl. 1. P. A.
-छ्रयति, -ते, -छ्रयितुम्, to raise well up, raise
up, to raise aloft, erect, elevate.

सम्-उच्छ्रय, अस्, m. raising aloft, elevation,
height; opposition, enmity.

सम्-उच्छ्राय, अस्, m. raising up, rising upwards,
elevation, height.

सम्-उच्छ्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, well raised or elevated,
high, lofty.

समुच्छ्वस् सम्-उच्-छ्वस् (-उद्-श्वस्). See rt.
श्वस्.

सम्-उच्छ्वसित, अस्, आ, अम्, sighing heavily or
deeply; (अम्), n. a heavy or deep sigh.

सम्-उच्छ्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, loosened, unfastened;
separated, divided.

सम्-उच्छ्वास, अस्, m. sighing deeply, heavy
expiration.

समुज्जिहीर्षु सम्-उज्-जिहीर्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr.
the Desid. of rt. हृ with उद् and सम्, see सम्-
उद्-धृ), desirous of raising up.

समुज्जृम्भ् सम्-उज्-जृम्भ् (-उद्-ज्˚), cl. 1. A.
-जृम्भते, &c., to gape wide open; to be extended
out, spread out; to break into sight, burst forth,
become visible, arise; to begin or strive (to do any-
thing).

समुज्ज्वल् सम्-उज्-ज्वल् (-उद्-ज्˚), cl. 1. P.
-ज्वलति, -ज्वलितुम्, to blaze up with great intensity,
shine very brightly.
सम्-उज्ज्वलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining very brightly.

समुज्झ् सम्-उज्झ्, cl. 6. P. -उज्झति, -उज्झि-
तुम्, to abandon or give up entirely, renounce; to
let go, discharge.

सम्-उज्झित, अस्, आ, अम्, quite given up, entirely
left or abandoned, deserted, quitted, renounced, re-
signed; let go, discharged; free from; (अम्), n.
that which is left, a remnant, leavings.

समुत्कण्ठ सम्-उत्कण्ठ, Nom. A. -उत्कण्-
ठते, &c., to think of with regret, long after.

समुत्कृत् सम्-उत्-कृत् (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P.
-कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut off or cut away entirely,
cut in pieces.

सम्-उत्कृत्य, ind. having completely cut off or
cut out.

समुत्कृष् सम्-उत्-कृष् (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P.
-कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw or
raise well up, raise up, elevate.

सम्-उत्कर्ष, अस्, m. exaltation; self-elevation,
setting one's self up (as belonging to a higher than
one's own tribe).
सम्-उत्कृष्य, ind. having drawn up.

समुत्कॄ सम्-उत्-कॄ (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P. -किरति,
&c., to pierce or perforate thoroughly, bore through.

सम्-उत्कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, completely perforated
or pierced.

समुत्क्रम् सम्-उत्-क्रम् (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P. A.
-क्रामति, -क्रमते, &c., to go upwards, ascend;
to overstep, pass over, transgress, violate, neglect,
omit.

सम्-उत्क्रम, अस्, m. going or rising upwards,
ascent; passing over; transgressing proper bounds.

सम्-उत्क्रम्य, ind. having passed or transgressed
proper bounds.

समुत्क्रुश् सम्-उत्-क्रुश् (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 1. P.
-क्रोशति, -क्रोष्टुम्, to cry out loudly, cry aloud,
make a loud noise.
सम्-उत्क्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, cried out, called out.

सम्-उत्क्रोश, अस्, m. crying out aloud; clamour;
an osprey.

सम्-उत्क्लिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly distressed or
disturbed, very uneasy or uncomfortable.

समुत्क्षिप् सम्-उत्-क्षिप् (-उद्-क्˚), cl. 6. P.
A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw up, toss up,
lift or raise up; to throw or toss about, scatter about;
to throw off, throw aside, loosen, liberate; to throw
or drive away, expel; to destroy.

सम्-उत्क्षिप्य, ind. having thrown up, having
lifted or raised up, having hoisted; having thrown
or tossed up, having tossed or scattered about.

समुत्खन् सम्-उत्-खन् (-उद्-ख्˚), cl. 1. P.
A. -खनति, -ते, &c., to dig up by the roots, eradi-
cate, exterminate or destroy utterly.
सम्-उत्खाय, ind. having utterly eradicated.
समुत्तिज् सम्-उत्-तिज् (-उद्-तिज्). See rt. तिज्.

सम्-उत्तेजन, अम्, n. the act of exciting or in-
flaming greatly, inciting, irritating.

सम्-उत्तेजित, अस्, आ, अम्, greatly excited or in-
flamed, incited, excited, irritated.

समुत्तॄ सम्-उत्-तॄ (-उद्-तॄ), cl. 1. P. -तरति,
&c., to pass out of, come out of (with abl., e. g.
जलात्, out of the water); to rise or come forth from;
to pass safely out of, escape; to pass through, go
through, break through, pass over or beyond, cross
over, cross.

सम्-उत्तरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, passing out of, com-
ing forth from, passing over or beyond, crossing.

सम्-उत्तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, come forth from;
escaped from; passed through, crossed, landed, &c.

सम्-उत्तीर्य, ind. having passed out of or come
forth from, having passed through, &c.

समुत्त्रस् सम्-उत्-त्रस् (-उद्-त्रस्). See rt.
2. त्रस्.

सम्-उत्त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thoroughly frightened,
greatly alarmed or terrified.

समुत्था सम्-उत्-था (-उद्-स्था), cl. 1. P. A.
-तिष्ठति, -ते, -थातुम्, to rise up together, rise
up, arise; to return to life: Caus. -थापयति, -यि-
तुम्, to raise up together, raise up, elevate, erect;
to re-animate, revive, restore to life.

सम्-उत्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, rising up, risen; arising,
arisen or produced from; occurring, occasioned.

सम्-उत्थान, अम्, n. the act of rising up toge-
ther, rising up, rising; recovering from sickness or
injury, perfect cure, healing of a wound or sore;
increase, increment, advance, growth; performance
of work, active occupation, effort, industry, (सम्-
भूय समुत्थान, the performance of work or
engaging in business after uniting with others,
co-operation, partnership); indication or symptom
of disease.
—समुत्थान-व्यय, अस्, m. the ex-
pense of recovery or cure.

सम्-उत्थाप्य, ind. having raised up, having
made or helped to stand up.
सम्-उत्थाय, ind. having risen up, having arisen.

सम्-उत्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, risen up together, started
up, risen, raised; recovered, cured, healed; swollen
up; increased; arisen, produced; derived, obtained.

समुत्पट् सम्-उत्-पट् (-उद्-प्˚), cl. 10. P.
-पाटयति, -यितुम्, to tear completely out, tear out
by the roots, root up, tear off; to draw out; to tear
away, detach, sever; to expel, dethrone.

सम्-उत्पाट, अस्, m. tearing completely out or
away, rooting up, eradication; tearing away from,
severing, detaching.

सम्-उत्पाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn up by the roots;
torn completely away, severed, detached.

सम्-उत्पाट्य, ind. having torn completely out or
away.

समुत्पत् सम्-उत्-पत् (-उद्-प्˚), cl. 1. P. -प-
[]
तति, -पतितुम्, to fly up together, fly upwards,
jump up, start up, spring up, rise, ascend, arise, be
produced; to rush out of, gush out; rush forth,
break forth; to fly away, depart, disappear; to rush
upon, attack, assail.

सम्-उत्पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying up together,
flying upwards, ascending.

सम्-उत्पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, flown up together,
flown upwards, ascended, sprung up, springing up-
wards; flown away, gone, departed, disappeared;
exerted.

सम्-उत्पत्य, ind. having flown upwards; having
flown away; having gushed out.

सम्-उत्पिपतिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.),
about to start up or spring up.

समुत्पिपतिषु सम्-उत्पिपतिषु. See सम्-
उत्-पत्.

समुत्पद् सम्-उत्-पद् (-उद्-प्˚), cl. 4. A. -पद्-
यते, -पत्तुम्, to spring up together; to spring up,
arise, come forth; to be brought forth or born or
produced, happen, come to pass, occur, take place;
to present one's self: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to arise, produce, effect, cause.

सम्-उत्पत्ति, इस्, f. arising together, arising, pro-
duction, birth, orgin; formation, occurrence, inci-
dence.

सम्-उत्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung up together,
arisen, produced, born, effected, excited; occurred,
happened, occurring, taking place.

सम्-उत्पादन, अम्, n. the act of bringing forth,
producing; effecting, fabricating.

सम्-उत्पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, brought forth, pro-
duced, effected, caused, formed.

समुत्पिञ्ज सम्-उत्पिञ्ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt.
पिञ्ज् with उद् and सम्), excessively confused or con-
founded, bewildered, disturbed, overcome; (अस्), m.
an army in great disorder; complete confusion.

सम्-उत्पिञ्जल = सम्-उत्पिञ्ज above; [cf. पिञ्-
जल, उत्पिञ्जल.]

सम्-उत्पिञ्जलक, अस्, m. excessive confusion or
disorder.

समुत्पिष् सम्-उत्पिष्, cl. 7. P. -पिनष्टि, &c.,
to crush or squeeze together; to grind to pieces.

सम्-उत्पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, crushed or squeezed
together; greatly crushed.

समुत्पीडन सम्-उत्पीडन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. पीड्
with उद् and सम्), the act of pressing together, com-
pression, pressing; great pressure or distress.

समुत्पॄ सम्-उत्-पॄ, Caus. -पारयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to spread out, stretch out, stretch forth.

समुत्प्लु सम्-उत्-प्लु (-उद्-प्˚), cl. 1. A. -प्ल-
वते, -प्लोतुम्, to jump or leap up together, spring up.
सम्-उत्प्लुत्य, ind. having jumped or leaped up.

समुत्सद् सम्-उत्-सद्, Caus. P. -सादयति,
-यितुम्, to destroy utterly, overturn, overthrow.

समुत्सव सम्-उत्सव, अस्, m. a great festival
or festivity.

समुत्सह् सम्-उत्-सह्, Caus. P. -साहयति,
-यितुम्, to encourage or exhort together, animate,
incite.
सम्-उत्साह्य, ind. having encouraged or exhorted.

समुत्सुक सम्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, very un-
easy or anxious, very agitated, anxiously desirous,
longing for (an absent person), eager for, fond of,
attached to; regretting, missing, grieving for, sor-
rowful.
—समुत्सुक-त्व, अम्, n. sorrow, regret,
longing desire.

सम्-उत्सुकय, Nom. P. -उत्सुकयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to long for, cause to be fond of, make
attached to.

समुत्सृ सम्-उत्-सृ (-उद्-सृ), Caus. P. -सार-
[]
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to move away, drive away;
to give away.

सम्-उत्सारण, अम्, n. the act of expelling or
driving to a distance, driving away; pursuing, hunt-
ing.

समुपास् सम्-उपास् (-उप-आस्), cl. 2. A.
-उपास्ते, &c., to sit near together or near each other;
to engage in or devote one's self to anything toge-
ther, practise in common; to serve or honour to-
gether.

समुपाश्रि सम्-उपा-श्रि (-उप-आ-), cl. 1. P.
A. -श्रयति, -ते, -श्रयितुम्, to have recourse to
together, resort to.

सम्-उपाश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, resorted to, having
recourse to.
सम्-उपासीन, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting near together.

समुपे सम्-उपे (-उप-इ, see rt. 5. इ), cl. 2.
P. -उपैति, &c., to come together, assemble, meet;
to go towards, go near to, approach, assail, attack; to
reach; to fall to the share, come into the possession
of; to go to any state or condition, undergo.

सम्-उपेत, अस्, आ, अम्, come together, assembled,
gone near to, approached, resorted to, visited; arrived
at; furnished with, possessed of, endowed with; in-
habited by.

सम्-उपेत्य, ind. having gone near to, having
approached.

सम्-उपेयिवस्, आन्, -युषी, अत्, one who has gone
near or approached; going, proceeding.

समुपेक्ष् सम्-उपेक्ष् (-उप-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
[]
-उपेक्षते (sometimes also P. -ति), -उपेक्षितुम्,
to look completely over or beyond, take no notice
of, overlook, disregard, neglect, abandon.

समुपोपविश् सम्-उपोप-विश् (-उप-उप-).
See rt. 1. विश्.

सम्-उपोपविष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, seated together,
sitting down.

समुपोष् सम्-उपोष् (-उप-उष्), cl. 1. P.
-उपोषति, &c., to burn together, consume together,
to burn up completely.

समुपोह् सम्-उपोह् (-उप-ऊह्, see rt. 1. ऊह्),
cl. 1. P. A. -उपोहति, -ते, &c., to bring near to,
draw towards; to bring into contact with.

समुब्ज् सम्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, -उब्जितुम्,
to cover over, close up; to press together.
सम्-उब्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered over, closed up.

समुभ् सम्-उभ्, cl. 9. 7. P. -उभ्नाति, -उनप्ति
(Impf. -उनप्), &c., Ved. to confine, shut up, cover
up, close up; to strike down, injure, mutilate.

समुल्लङ्घ् सम्-उल्-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. -लङ्घ-
यति, &c., to leap beyond, violate, transgress,
neglect.

समुल्लम्ब् सम्-उल्-लम्ब् (-उद्-लम्ब्). See rt.
लम्ब्.

सम्-उल्लम्बित, अस्, आ, अम्, quite erect, upright;
(according to some) hanging.

समुल्लस् सम्-उल्-लस् (-उद्-लस्), cl. 1. P. -ल-
सति, -लसितुम्, to shine forth brightly, gleam, glitter;
to break forth, appear; to jump or dance about,
sport, be wanton: Caus. -लासयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to jump or sport, exhilarate, make glad.

सम्-उल्लसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, shining very brightly,
brilliant; dancing about, sporting, playing, wan-
toning.

सम्-उल्लसित, अस्, आ, अम्, shining forth, gleaming,
brilliant, beautiful; sportive, sporting.

सम्-उल्लास, अस्, m. excessive brilliance; sporting,
exhilaration.

समुल्लिख् सम्-उल्-लिख् (-उद्-लिख्), cl. 6. P.
-लिखति, &c., to scratch up, tear up, dig up, furrow,
scarify; to rub against, graze; to write down.

सम्-उल्लिखत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, scratching up,
tearing up.

समुल्लुप् सम्-उल्-लुप्, cl. 6. P. A. -लुम्पति,
-ते, &c., Ved. to seize upon, lay hold of, pick up.

सम्-उल्लुप्य, ind. having seized upon, having
caught hold of.

समुष् सम्-उष्, cl. 1. P. -ओषति, &c., to
burn up or consume by fire.

समूर समूर, अस्, m. a kind of deer, (see
below.)

समूरु, उस्, m. a kind of deer (the skin of
which may be used as a student's seat, &c.; accord-
ing to some it has a white mane).
समूरुक, अस्, m. = समूरु above.

समूह् सम्-ऊह् (see rt. 1. ऊह्; cf. सं-वह्),
[]
cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, -ऊहितुम्, to bring together,
gather together, collect, unite; to bring or place
back in right order: Caus. -ऊहयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to be brought together, bring together.

सम्मुह् सम्-मुह्, cl. 4. P. -मुह्यति, &c.,
to become quite stupefied or unconscious; to be
bewildered or disturbed or confounded; to become
unconscious: Caus. -मोहयति, -यितुम्, to stupefy,
make unconscious, confound, bewilder, perplex, in-
fatuate, lead astray.

सम्-ऊह, अस्, m. a collection, assemblage, aggre-
gation, aggregate, accumulation, heap, number, mul-
titude, quantity.
—समूह-कार्य, अम्, n. the
business or affairs of a community.

सम्-ऊहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, bringing together, col-
lecting, gathering; contracting.

सम्-ऊहन, अम्, n. the act of bringing together,
collection; plenty; (ई), f. a broom.
सम्मुखिन्, ई, m. a looking-glass, mirror.

सम्मुखीन, अस्, आ, अम्, facing, being in face
of, face to face, confronting, before, in front, op-
posite.

सम्मुर्छ् सम्-मुर्छ्, cl. 1. P. -मूर्छति, &c.,
to congeal into a fixed form, acquire density or con-
sistency, become dense, thicken, coagulate; to be-
come stupid or senseless, become stupefied or insen-
sible; to acquire firmness or strength, grow stronger
or more intense, increase, expand, become powerful:
Caus. -मूर्छयति, -यितुम्, to cause to assume form
or consistency, form, fashion; to stupefy, cause to
faint.

सम्-मूर्छ, (perhaps) thickening, augmenting,
increase, expansion, spreading.
—सम्मूर्छ-ज,
अस्, m. grass or any gramineous plant.

सम्-मूर्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming more
intense, increasing, spreading, pervading.

सम्-मूर्छन, अम्, n. the act of congealing or
becoming dense; stupefaction, insensibility, fainting
away; increasing or spreading in all directions,
universal pervasion, entire permeation, expansion,
co-extension; height, elevation.
—सम्मूर्छनोद्-
भव (˚न-उद्˚), अस्, m. a fish or other aquatic
animal.

सम्-मूर्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, coagulated, congealed,
thickened; stupefied, senseless, unconscious; inten-
sified, increased.

सामुदायिक सामुदायिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सम्-
उदाय), belonging to a multitude or assemblage,
collective.

1. सामुद्रक, अम्, n., N. of a work describing
the various marks on the bodies of men and women,
(so called, according to one account, because com-
posed by Samudra; see 2. सामुद्र below.)
—सामु-
द्रक-विद्या, f. the art of interpreting the marks
of the body, palmistry.
2. सामुद्रक, अम्, n. sea-salt.

1. सामुद्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to marks on the
body, (सामुद्रिका गुनाः, qualities denoted by
marks on the body); connected with good or bad
fortune supposed to be indicated by marks or spots
on the body; (अस्), m. an interpreter or describer of
marks or spots on the body; a fortune-teller; (अम्),
n. palmistry, N. of a work on this subject; [cf.
1. सामुद्रक above.]
—सामुद्रिकाचार्य (˚क-
आच्˚), अस्, m. a proper N.

2. सामुद्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the sea or
ocean, oceanic.
सामुद्रि, इस्, m. a patronymic.

साम्मुख्य साम्मुख्य, अम्, n. (fr. सम्-मुख),
the state of being present face to face or in front,
presence, favour, countenance.
